description:
# TL;DR

**The task exists but the board is wrong: it is marked done, and nothing was built.** Fix the orchestrator bug, re-open the card, re-run it.

1. **Task:** *Kanban and chats management improvement* — id `a9906517-5603-44a1-bf64-7bb4b78ccb48`, board `codx-junior maintenance` › column `Done`, status `done` 100 %, sprint `Run: Board column sort methods`.
2. **Reality:** it was closed as **BLOCKED** — no worker ever started, no file touched; the card reached `Done` only because the orchestrator called `finish` after the failure.
3. **Cause (one-line fix):** `TaskManager.create_task() got an unexpected keyword argument 'estimation_cost'` — drop the argument at the call site or accept it in `api/codx/junior/tasks/manager.py::create_task`.
4. **Nothing is lost:** the closing report holds the full verified design (per-column `sort` default `unread`, 9 modes, `unread_counts`, server-side paginated column endpoint, client cleanup) — no re-discovery needed.
5. **Next step for you to decide:** fix the bug and re-run the original objective in a new increment, or park it behind current work — say which and I'll move the card and set the date.

I'll look it up on the board.# TL;DR

The task exists — but the board is lying to you: it is marked **done** when in fact **nothing was implemented**. It was closed as **BLOCKED by an infrastructure bug** in the orchestrator (no code touched).

- **Where:** board `codx-junior maintenance` › column `Done` · status `done` · progress 100 %
- **Name:** "Lanban and chats management improvement" (typo for *Kanban…*) · id `a9906517-5603-44a1-bf64-7bb4b78ccb48`
- **Sprint:** `Run: Board column sort methods` (+ `codx-junior maintenance`) — a sprint was even named after this feature
- **Reality:** the design is complete and preserved in the closing report, the implementation never ran
- **I verified it myself:** `api/codx/junior/kanban/model.py` has **no** `COLUMN_SORT_METHODS` constant → the per-column sort setting does not exist in the backend

---

## 1. The task

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| ID | `a9906517-5603-44a1-bf64-7bb4b78ccb48` (short: `a9906517`) |
| Name | Lanban and chats management improvement |
| Board / Column | `codx-junior maintenance` / `Done` |
| Status / Progress | `done` / 100 % — **wrong** |
| Sprints | `codx-junior maintenance`, `Run: Board column sort methods` |
| Profiles | `orchestrator`, `reviewer` (no developer owner) |
| Created / Closed | 2026-11-09 09:17 → 2026-11-09 09:42 |

The original request (first message, verbatim) is exactly what you described:

> *"Add sort method setting for board columns: Last changed · Unread [default] · Manual (drag & drop) … We'll need new column settings and fix server side endpoints so we don't load all chats."*

## 2. Why it is not actually delivered

The run died **before any worker started**: every worker card failed at creation with

```
TaskManager.create_task() got an unexpected keyword argument 'estimation_cost'
```

- reproducible on retry, identical for two different profiles → call-site/signature skew, not a content problem
- zero steps executed, repository untouched
- the orchestrator then called `finish` → run marked **completed** → the card went to **Done**

**One-line fix:** either drop `estimation_cost` at the orchestrator call site or accept it in `api/codx/junior/tasks/manager.py::create_task`. After that the objective can be re-run verbatim — the 8-step plan needs no redesign.

## 3. What survives (good news — no re-discovery needed)

The blocked report carries the full verified design:
- `sort` (+ reserved `sort_dir`) persisted per column in `_normalize_columns`, default `unread`, inherit-on-omit, no migration
- 9 modes with tie-breakers: `unread` (default), `last_changed`, `manual`, `priority`, `due_date`, `created`, `cost`, `name`, `status`
- denormalised `unread_counts` on `Chat` with a `read_by` fallback
- server-side, paginated per-column grid endpoint with dataset-wide totals (no client-side listing/sorting/metrics)
- client cleanup removing the client-side column building in `$storex.chats`

## 4. Related, but not the same thing

| ID | Task | Status | Scope |
|---|---|---|---|
| `94a8c66e` | Sprint columns order | `ui` (board `codx-junior maintenance` / `To Do`) | **Board-level** "Task order" dropdown (attention / priority / manual / last updated / newest) — already implemented, not per-column, not server-side |
| `a12bf287` | Allow reorder board columns | `todo` | Column **order**, not task order |
| `ed124855` | Columns settings | `done` | Column `project_id` + `profiles` defaults — the persistence pattern the sort setting must copy |

## 5. What I recommend (needs your go-ahead — 2 minutes)

1. **Decision needed:** correct the board — move `a9906517` out of `Done` to `To Do` and reopen it with the preserved design as the description. *Recommend: yes*, otherwise the next status review reports this feature as shipped.
2. **New task (small, `software_developer`):** fix the `estimation_cost` orchestrator bug — it blocks *every* orchestrated run, not just this one. **This is on the critical path.**
3. **After 2 lands:** re-run the column-sort objective as **two increments**, each deployable and demoable:
   - **M1** — per-column `sort` setting persisted + server-side sorted/filtered endpoint for one board → demo: switch a column to "Unread" and see the order change with real data
   - **M2** — remaining 8 modes + drop the client-side chat listing/metrics → demo: a 1000-chat project board loads without downloading every chat

Say the word and I'll create tasks 2 and 3 and move the card — I won't touch the board until you confirm.
